name: Ledbetter Fair Pay Act
excerpt: The Ledbetter Fair Pay Act allows lawsuits for pay discrimination within 180 days of each discriminatory paycheck.
notes: The Ledbetter Fair Pay Act was enacted after a woman successfully sued for being paid less than her male counterparts for 19 years. It allows individuals to file a lawsuit for pay discrimination within 180 days of receiving a discriminatory paycheck.
context_summary:
- Allows lawsuits for pay discrimination.
- Lawsuits can be filed within 180 days of receiving a discriminatory paycheck.
- Enacted after a woman sued for being paid less than male counterparts for 19 years.
